report.summary: Attacks: Indirect prompt injection via tool outputs (Greshake et al. 2023) achieved 100% success hiding payloads in search results; code injection in repositories (Silent Spring attack on Copilot) produced malicious suggestions. Defenses: Instruction hierarchy tagging (Wallace et al.) reduced attack success to near zero; output monitoring and prompt sanitization help but are evadable. No defense fully robust yet.

handoff.suggestion: Adopt instruction hierarchy with trusted output tags for all tool replies; pilot with dual LLM output sanitizer.
